summary: Anheuser-Busch InBev filed a Form 6-K with its second quarter 2026 results, a routine earnings report for a foreign private issuer. The filing discloses quarterly and half-year financial and operating metrics: revenue up 5.6% (reported +11.0% to $16.66B), underlying EPS up 23.4% to $1.21, normalized EBITDA up 5.8%, and net debt to EBITDA at 2.86x. No strategic transaction, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is present. The exhibit is a standard earnings press release, with no deal terms, board actions, or structural changes. This filing does not qualify as a special situation and is categorized as None.
